event_summary: A bright orange-yellow cloud expands and dims into a larger gray-brown smoke plume against a black background.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a compact, bright yellow-orange billowing cloud near the center of a black scene. The cloud enlarges outward and upward, with rounded glowing lobes forming across its top and sides. A pale gray-brown lower cloud spreads along the bottom while a central vertical plume becomes visible. Over time the orange glow becomes more localized, mainly in the upper right and inner areas, while the surrounding cloud turns darker gray-brown. By the end, the visible form is a tall, broad smoke-like plume with only faint reddish-orange glow near the upper portion.

reasons: The main cloud is already present and bright in the first frame.
No pre-event state or source object is visible.
The background is black with no visible surrounding environment.
